verdict.rationale: x402 is an open, vendor-neutral standard. Its protocol SDK is published on public npm by the x402 Foundation, and sellers add the payment requirement to their own resource servers, so the protocol layer runs on infrastructure you control. However, the documented settlement and verification component is the CDP Facilitator, described only as a hosted service, and nothing documents running your own facilitator. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted facilitator, a self-hosting deployment guide, and hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted payment flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
